I grow beans on this quarter-hectare plot because they help feed my family and improve the soil. I will not buy chemical fertilizer for this plot — beans do not need it the way maize does, and I must save what little I have for my main maize field. I will spread manure from my goats before planting, and I will use seed I saved from last season's harvest. My children and I can manage all the work ourselves — planting, weeding twice, and harvesting — so I do not need to hire anyone.
